name: Yamada Asaemon
source:
Died at the age of 48.

One of the escapees from Hell, and [url=https://vndb.org/c107330]Shinobikuni[/url]'s aide. The name is passed down through generations of heads of the Yamada family, a clan of executioners from the Edo period.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/asaemon/]Aksys Games[/url]]
